rules.description: Edge cache HTML for public marketing pages
rules.expression: ((http.request.uri.path eq "/") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/comprar-backlinks")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pacotes-de-backlinks")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ferramentas")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/blog")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/glossario-de-backlinks")) or (http.request.uri.path eq "/qmix") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/servicos") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/contato") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/perguntas-frequentes") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/comprar-guest-post") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/vender-backlinks") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/termos-de-uso") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/politica-de-privacidade") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/politica-de-cookies") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/politica-de-reembolso")) and (http.host ne "backlinkguard.qmix.com.br")
